notes.title: Update v1.0.4.4
notes.content:
[h1]Change list:[/h1]

[h2][list]
[*] Fix netcode, now if you are a client, there will be no lags due to ping or low host FPS
[*] Reworked the pushing system - now it works more smoothly
[*] Added banner of our upcoming game
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: Update v1.0.4.3
notes.content:
[h1]Change list:[/h1]

[h2][list]
[*] Added restart button in single player game
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: Update v1.0.4.2
notes.content:
[h1]Change list:[/h1]

[h2][list]
[*] The ‘An absolute legend!’ achievement now works correctly for clients (previously it didn't count the client using the checkpoint load)
[*] Added new path (without bed-skips)
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: Update v1.0.4.1
notes.content:
[h1]Change list:[/h1]

[h2][list]
[*] Fix for the ‘An absolute legend!’ achievement. Now it can be obtained only for passing without checkpoints
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: Update v1.0.4 | TRADING CARDS
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone, Trading Cards have finally been added to the game![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253328/3f6b1ce738db8644a00c989d96d265da329dcf3d.png[/img]
[h1]List of changes:[/h1]

[h2][list]
[*] Added trading cards. To get at least one card you need to spend 5 minutes in the game.
[*] Added 3 achievements
[*] Added French localisation
[*] Fixed translation in some languages
[*] Added translation of loading screens.
[/list][/h2]

[h1][url=https://discord.com/invite/ACsU98ZFCA]DISCORD! [/url][/h1]

notes.title: Update v1.0.3.3
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes:[/h1]

[h2][list]
[*] The character ragdoll feature has been removed.
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: Update v1.0.3.2
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes:[/h1]

[h2][list]
[*] Fix bug when you could get out of the initial location before the start of the timer. This way you could easily set a world record.
[/list][/h2]

[h2]From the leaderboard were removed 2 people who used this bug and they were given compensation in the form of keys from the game Only Up: SKIBIDI TOGETHER.[/h2]

notes.title: HOTFIX v1.0.3.1
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes:[/h1]

[list]
[h2][*] Fixed one path closer to the end of the map, in build 1.0.3 it was out of reach[/h2]
[/list]

[h1]Do not forget to inform your friends to update the game. Otherwise there may be problems with the connection.[/h1]

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes:[/h1]

[list]
[h2][*]Changed the location of checkpoints #2 and #6
[*] Added alternative paths
[*] Added new cuts
[*] Fixed collisions
[*] Fixed pushing of lizards. Now they are pushed correctly
[*] Fixed translation for Russian localisation
[*] Removed the shoulder change setting as it was not needed
[*] Camera change is now assigned to the F5 key by default
[*] Updated boot screens [/h2]
[/list]
